result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.add_balanced_tree()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Add a balanced k-ary tree to the current graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L2071-L2180){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.add_balanced_tree( k, h, type=None, label=True, rel=None, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Balanced tree](/assets/graphs/struct-balanced-tree.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="A complete binary tree of height 3: fifteen nodes on four levels (1 + 2 + 4 + 8). Every internal node has exactly two children and every leaf sits at the same depth, illustrating the balanced structure produced by add_balanced_tree(k=2, h=3). The root at the top is shown in the accent color." width="100%"} Creates a tree where each internal node has exactly `k` children, with height `h`. The total number of nodes will be equal to `(k^(h+1) - 1) / (k - 1)`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of children per node (branching factor). [h]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Height of the tree (root has height 0). [type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional node type/category for all nodes. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[True]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, label nodes with their IDs. [rel]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Optional[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional relationship (`rel`) label for all edges. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} A balanced tree with branching factor `k` and height `h` has `(k^(h+1) - 1) / (k - 1)` nodes in total. A binary tree (`k=2`) of height `3` therefore has `1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15` nodes -- one root, two children, four grandchildren, and eight leaves: ::: {#59619dcf .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_balanced_tree(k=2, h=3) ) graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 15 ``` ::: :::
